visits.reason: The active rule excludes household activity.

visits.first_sentence: Someone who arrived from outside the property came into view on the Left side camera at 6:13 PM.
visits.title: C · After dark: side gate and the shed gap
visits.story: Someone who arrived from outside the property came into view on the Left side camera at 6:13 PM. They touched the side gate at 6:14 PM. Not observed for 41 s: they left the Left side view toward the area behind the shed, which no camera covers. Vigil can't confirm what happened there. They came back into view on the Left side camera at 6:15 PM and walked back through the side gate. They left past the Front entrance camera at 6:16 PM.
visits.role_basis: arrived from outside the property (side alley)
visits.reason: An owner rule fired for this visit.
